newsitem.title: USA: NYC Mac sells $75 mln of bonds to retail-JP Morgan.
newsitem.headline: NYC Mac sells $75 mln of bonds to retail-JP Morgan.

text.p: Retail investors bought at least $75 million of bonds from the Municipal Assistance Corp for New York City during the one-day presale period, the lead underwriter said on Monday.
"It's at least $75 million and we're counting," said an official with JP Morgan Securities Inc. The MAC is selling $543 million of bonds on Wednesday.
